title: 第十一章 石洞栖伤 劫影暗侵第十二章 凶蚁吞山隅 毒噬扰清修

古道妖氛渐散，山风复归平和，唯余满地残枝碎叶，留得方才恶战痕迹。黑风古妖王遁走，余妖尽灭，然何月重伤垂危，四人再无前行之态，满心皆在伤者身上。
何年俯身，小心翼翼将何月横抱而起，指尖触及其身，只觉一片冰凉，月华灵气涣散如沙，经脉之中蛮荒煞气肆意冲撞，神府摇摇欲坠，原本温润澄澈的眸光，此刻黯淡无光，唇角血迹未干，更显孱弱。他心头揪紧，往日沉稳神色尽覆疼惜，步履沉稳，朝着山腰那处清幽石洞缓步而行。
花月初紧随身侧，纤手轻抬，缕缕翠绿草木灵韵萦绕指尖，一路渡入何月体内，护住其心脉，暂缓煞气侵体之势，柔声叮嘱：“月神本源受损，神基动荡，万不可颠簸惊扰，需尽快入洞静坐，以纯和灵气温养，方能稳住伤势，不致伤及根本。”
何日亦敛了往日跳脱，满脸愧疚与担忧，快步上前，欲要分担，却见何年抱持极稳，只得转身在前开路，周身骄阳金光内敛，细细清扫洞口周遭残存妖煞，杜绝一切侵扰，沉声道：“我这就守在洞外，绝不许任何邪祟靠近，惊扰阿姐静养！”
不多时，四人行至石洞前。此洞隐于古木虬枝之间，洞口窄小，内里却宽敞干燥，石床、石案天然天成，无风雨侵袭，无浊气干扰，天地灵气虽不似幽谷浓郁，却清和纯净，最适宜疗伤静养。洞口草木葱茏，可遮身形，可挡阴风，实乃绝佳静养之所。
入得洞内，何年轻轻将何月安放于石床之上，让其盘膝坐定，双手轻叠于膝，助其调整调息姿态。花月初即刻立于石床旁侧，不再耽搁，周身草木灵韵尽数铺开，淡绿光雾弥漫洞内，纯净温和，不含半分戾气，丝丝缕缕渗入何月肌理，循其经脉游走，包裹住四处乱窜的蛮荒煞气。
“月神，你且稳住心神，运转残存月华灵气，随我灵韵而动，我以草木生机之力，为你涤荡经脉煞气，修补受损经脉。你切勿强行催动神力，只需顺其自然，护住神府本源即可。”花月初柔声开口，语气沉稳，指尖结印，草木时序诀全力运转，引动天地间清和生机，尽数汇入何月体内。
草木之道，主生发、主调和，最善修复创伤、化解阴煞，恰好克制黑风妖王那等蛮荒暴戾之气。翠绿灵韵所过之处，霸道凶戾的煞气渐渐被包裹、消融，不再肆意冲撞经脉，紊乱的气机缓缓趋于平稳。
何月闭目凝神，依言而行，残存月华之力顺着草木灵韵流转，面色稍稍褪去惨白，多了一丝浅淡血色，呼吸也渐趋平稳，不再似方才那般微弱急促。可每一次灵气游走，经脉皆是刺痛难忍，她生性坚韧，即便身受重创，也紧咬双唇，不发一声**，唯有眉心微蹙，显露痛楚。
何年立于石床一侧，静静看着，满心自责。他身为兄长，执掌时序大道，本该护好弟妹，护好同行之人，却在古道之上，未提前勘破妖邪埋伏，未能及时拦下妖王致命一击，令何月舍身护阵，落得重伤之果。
他缓缓闭目，运转《六千字文》时序大道，引动洞内天地清和灵气，化作莹白时序光韵，缓缓笼罩何月周身，以岁月沉淀之力，稳固其神府，修补其受损神基，放缓其灵气耗损之速。时序之道，可逆转微末生机，稳固神魂道基，与草木生机之力相辅相成，双管齐下，何月伤势愈发稳定，动荡的月华本源，渐渐收拢，不再涣散。
“多亏有你草木灵诀相助，方能如此快稳住阿姐伤势。”何年睁开眼，看向身旁花月初，眸中满是感激，语气低沉，“此番若非你在，阿姐经脉被煞气侵蚀，恐难这般平稳。”
花月初回眸，浅浅一笑，眸光温润，轻声答道：“你我同行，本就该彼此照应，何须言谢。月神慈悲，舍身护众，道心可敬，我不过是尽己所能，化解其伤痛罢了。”
她顿了顿，眉宇微凝，语气转而凝重：“只是妖王妖力霸道，煞气侵体极深，虽暂时稳住伤势，驱散表层煞气，可仍有一丝凶煞侵入神府深处，难以即刻涤荡。月华本源受损过重，非一朝一夕可复原，需在此地静心静养三五日，持续以生机灵气温养，方能彻底清除余煞，修补经脉，待月华灵气稳固，方可再度启程。”
何年颔首，神色郑重：“既如此，我们便在此地栖居静养，直至阿姐伤势痊愈。我守洞口，运转时序大阵，隔绝内外气机，杜绝妖邪魔祟窥探；你在洞内，持续为阿姐温养疗伤；何日巡守洞外山林，肃清余孽，警戒四方，确保此间安宁，绝不许任何惊扰。”
二人当即应下，各司其职。
花月初寸步不离石床，昼夜以草木灵韵温养何月，时不时摘取洞外灵草奇花，汲取纯净生机灵气，渡入其体内，加速经脉修复，消解神府余煞。她耐心至极，即便耗费自身灵元，也毫无保留，只为让何月早日痊愈。
何年踏出石洞，立于山腰平坦之处，双手掐动天篆道诀，《六千字文》经文流转周身，莹白时序道纹自脚下蔓延开来，化作一道无形屏障，笼罩整个石洞与周遭数里之地。屏障之内，灵气平和，时序安稳，隔绝一切外界气机，任凭何等妖邪魔祟，也难以窥探洞内虚实，难以突破屏障侵扰。
他盘膝坐于洞口，一边镇守阵法，警戒四方，一边参悟大道，融合时序与草木之道。每每运转功法，便会想起花月初在洞内疗伤的身影，想起她温婉坚定的神色，心底那丝情愫，愈发深沉，却又被他藏于心底，只化作守护众人、护她周全的决心。

经古道一战，他愈发明白，历劫之路，步步凶险，魔界与妖邪环伺，稍有不慎，便会令身边之人身陷险境。他必须尽快精进修为，彻底解封年神本源，方能在往后劫难中，护住弟妹，护住花月初，护得同行之人周全，方能不负救世使命，不负这场尘缘相遇。
何日则谨遵兄长吩咐，周身骄阳金光内敛，穿梭于洞外山林之间，一遍遍巡查，肃清逃窜的残余小妖，排查周遭潜藏的凶险，将一切隐患扼杀于萌芽。他不再似往日那般莽撞冲动，一路巡守，格外谨慎，心中满是愧疚，只恨自己当初未能挡住黑风妖王，令阿姐身受重伤，此后唯有拼尽全力守护，方能弥补心中缺憾。
白日里，山林静谧，阳光透过树叶，洒下斑驳光影，洞外灵气祥和，无波无澜；入夜后，月色清辉洒落，虫鸣低吟，唯有何日巡守的脚步声，与洞内平稳的灵气流转之声，交织在一起，岁月暂得安稳。
洞内，何月静坐调息，在花月初与何年双重力道温养下，伤势日渐好转。神府余煞渐渐被清除，受损经脉慢慢修复，涣散的月华灵气重新汇聚，周身渐渐泛起浅淡银辉，面色愈发红润，眉心痛楚也渐渐消散。
这一日，何月缓缓睁开双眸，眸光已复往日温润，虽仍有几分虚弱，却已无此前孱弱之态，周身月华灵气平稳流转，虽未恢复巅峰实力，却已无性命之忧，可自行调息静养。
“多谢月初仙子，连日耗费灵元，为我疗伤；多谢兄长，日夜镇守，护我周全；多谢三弟，巡守警戒，保此间安宁。”何月轻声开口，声音虽柔和，却满是真挚感激，“此番连累众人停滞不前，耗费心神，实乃我之过。”
“阿姐何须言此！”何日恰好从洞外归来，听闻此言，连忙开口，满脸愧疚，“都怪我无能，没能挡住那妖王，才让你身受重伤，该说抱歉的是我。你安心静养，不必顾及前路，待你彻底痊愈，我们再一同启程，绝不着急。”
花月初浅浅一笑，递过一缕草木灵气，助其稳固灵气：“月神不必自责，你舍身护众，乃大义之举。如今伤势渐愈，便是最好，此后只需静心调息，补足元气即可，前路漫漫，不急于一时。”
何年亦走进洞内，看着何月好转，心头大石落地，温声道：“一家人，同行之人，本就该患难与共，彼此守护，何来连累之说。你安心静养，此间有阵法守护，安宁无虞，待元气彻底复原，我们再议前路。”
何月看着众人关切神色，心中暖意流转，轻轻颔首，不再多言，再度闭目，自行运转月华灵气，温养本源，修补残存暗伤。
洞内一时陷入静谧，唯有灵气流转之声，平和安宁。
可这份安宁，终究只是暂时。

The evil atmosphere of the ancient road gradually dissipated, and the mountain breeze returned to peace. Only the broken branches and leaves on the ground were left, leaving traces of the fierce battle just now. The ancient Black Wind Demon King escaped, and the remaining demons were wiped out. However, He Yue was seriously injured and was dying. The four of them could no longer move forward, and their hearts were focused on the injured.
He Nian leaned over and carefully lifted He Yue up. When his fingertips touched his body, he felt a coldness. The moonlight spiritual energy was as scattered as sand. The wild evil energy in the meridians collided wantonly. The divine palace was crumbling. His originally warm and clear eyes were now dim. The blood on the corners of his lips was not dry, making him look even weaker. His heart was clenched, his usual calm expression was replaced by a look of care and concern, and he walked slowly towards the quiet cave on the mountainside with steady steps.
Hua Yue followed closely beside her, raising her slender hands lightly, and the aura of green grass and trees lingered on her fingertips, all the way into He Yue's body, protecting her heart and pulse, delaying the evil spirit from invading her body, and warned softly: "The origin of the Moon God is damaged, and the foundation of the God is in turmoil. Do not be disturbed by bumps. You need to sit in the cave as soon as possible, and nourish yourself with pure spiritual energy, so that you can stabilize the injury and avoid damaging the foundation."
He Ri also suppressed his previous escape, with a face full of guilt and worry, and stepped forward quickly, wanting to share the burden, but seeing that He Nian held on very firmly, he had to turn around and open the way. The scorching golden light around him was restrained, and he carefully swept away the remaining evil spirits around the entrance of the cave to prevent any intrusion. He said in a deep voice: "I will stay outside the cave. I will never allow any evil spirits to approach and disturb my sister's rest!"
Not long after, the four of them arrived in front of the cave. This cave is hidden among the branches of ancient trees. The entrance is narrow, but the inside is spacious and dry. The stone bed and stone table are natural, without wind and rain, and no turbidity interference. Although the spiritual energy of heaven and earth is not as rich as the deep valley, it is clear and pure, and is most suitable for healing and rest. The lush vegetation at the entrance of the cave can cover your body and block the wind, making it an excellent place to rest.
After entering the cave, He Nian gently placed He Yue on the stone bed and asked him to sit cross-legged. He gently folded his hands on his knees to help him adjust his breathing posture. Hua Yue immediately stood next to the stone bed, without further delay, the aura of the vegetation spread all over the body, and the light green light mist filled the cave. It was pure and gentle, without even a hint of violence, and penetrated into He Yue's texture, traveling along its meridians, wrapping up the wild evil energy that was scurrying around.
"Moon God, please keep your mind steady and circulate the remaining moonlight spiritual energy to follow my aura. I will use the vitality of vegetation to cleanse the evil energy from your meridians and repair the damaged meridians. You must not force your divine power, just let nature take its course and protect the origin of the divine palace." Hua Yue spoke softly, her tone was calm, her fingertips formed seals, and the Herbal Time Sequence Technique was running at full strength, stimulating the peace and vitality between heaven and earth, and all of them merged into He Yue's body.
The way of grass and trees is responsible for hair growth and harmony. It is best at repairing wounds and resolving evil spirits. It just restrains the wild and violent spirit of the Black Wind Demon King. Wherever the emerald green aura passes, the domineering and ferocious evil spirits are gradually wrapped up and melted away. They no longer wantonly collide with the meridians, and the chaotic qi movement slowly becomes stable.
He Yue closed her eyes and concentrated, and followed her words. The remaining power of the moonlight flowed along the aura of the plants and trees. Her complexion gradually faded away from the pale color, and gained a hint of blood color. Her breathing gradually became steady, no longer as weak and rapid as before. But every time the spiritual energy wandered, her meridians were stinging unbearably. She was tough by nature. Even if she was seriously injured, she would bite her lips tightly and not utter a word. Only her eyebrows were slightly furrowed, showing the pain.
He Nian stood on the side of the stone bed, watching quietly, full of self-blame. As the elder brother, he was in charge of the Avenue of Time. He should have protected his brothers and sisters and those who walked with him. However, he failed to detect the evil ambush in advance on the ancient road and failed to stop the demon king's fatal blow in time. He Yue sacrificed his life to protect the formation and was seriously injured.
He slowly closed his eyes and circulated the "Six Thousand Character Essay" Time Sequence Avenue, stimulating the pure and harmonious spiritual energy of the heaven and earth in the cave, turning it into a crystal white time sequence light, slowly covering He Yue's body, using the power of years of precipitation to stabilize his divine palace, repair his damaged divine foundation, and slow down the rate of depletion of his spiritual energy. The way of timing can reverse the weak vitality, stabilize the foundation of the soul, and complement each other with the vitality of vegetation. A two-pronged approach, why?Yue's injury became more and more stable, and the origin of the turbulent Yuehua gradually gathered and no longer dispersed.
"Thanks to the help of your grass and tree spirit art, I was able to stabilize my sister's injury so quickly." He Nian opened his eyes and looked at Hua Yue beside him, his eyes full of gratitude, and his tone was low, "If you hadn't been here this time, my sister's meridians would have been eroded by evil spirits, and it would be difficult to be so stable."
Hua Yue looked back, smiled slightly, her eyes were warm, and she replied softly: "You and I are traveling together. We should take care of each other, so there is no need to say thank you. The Moon God is compassionate, sacrifices himself to protect others, and has a respectable Taoist heart. I am just trying my best to resolve his pain."
She paused, her brows slightly narrowed, and her tone turned solemn: "It's just that the demon king's demonic power is domineering, and the evil energy invades the body very deeply. Although the injury is temporarily stabilized and the superficial evil energy is dispersed, there is still a trace of evil that invades the depths of the divine palace, which is difficult to clean up immediately. Yuehua's origin has been severely damaged and cannot be restored overnight. It is necessary to meditate here for three to five days and continue to nourish it with vitality spiritual energy. Only then can the remaining evil spirits be completely eliminated and the meridians repaired. Only when Yuehua's spiritual energy is stable can we set off again. "
He Nian nodded, with a solemn expression: "In that case, we will live here and rest until my sister recovers from her injuries. I will guard the entrance of the cave and run the time sequence formation to isolate the internal and external energy and prevent evil spirits from prying into me. You will continue to warm and heal my sister in the cave. He will patrol the mountains and forests outside the cave to clear away the remaining evil and guard the surroundings to ensure the peace of this place. No disturbance is allowed."
The two immediately responded and performed their duties.
Huayue never leaves the stone bed, nourishing Heyue with the aura of grass and trees day and night. From time to time, he picks the magical grass and flowers outside the cave to absorb the pure vitality and spiritual energy, and transfers it into his body to accelerate the repair of his meridians and eliminate the remaining evil spirits in the divine palace. She was extremely patient, even if she spent her own spiritual energy, she would not hold anything back, just to let He Yue recover as soon as possible.
He Nian stepped out of the cave, stood on a flat spot on the mountainside, pinched the Tianzhu Taoist secrets with both hands, and the "Six Thousand Character Classic" scriptures circulated around him. The white time sequence Tao patterns spread from his feet, turning into an invisible barrier, covering the entire cave and the surrounding areas for several miles. Within the barrier, the spiritual energy is peaceful, the time sequence is stable, and all external energy is isolated. No matter how evil and evil spirits are, it is difficult to see into the reality of the cave, and it is difficult to break through the barrier.
He sat cross-legged at the entrance of the cave, guarding the formation and guarding all directions, while at the same time comprehending the great road, integrating the time sequence and the way of vegetation. Every time he used the technique, he would think of Hua Yue's figure healing in the cave, and her gentle and firm look. The affection in his heart would become deeper and deeper, but he would hide it in his heart and turn it into the determination to protect everyone and protect her.
After a battle on the ancient road, he came to understand more and more that the road through tribulations was dangerous and dangerous at every step, surrounded by demons and evil spirits. The slightest carelessness would put the people around him in danger. He must improve his cultivation as soon as possible and completely unlock the origin of the Nian God, so that he can protect his younger siblings, Hua Yue, and those who travel with him in the future disasters, so that he can live up to his mission of saving the world and live up to this fateful encounter.
Heri obeyed his brother's instructions, the scorching golden light of the sun was restrained, and he shuttled through the mountains and forests outside the cave, patrolling again and again to eliminate the remaining escaped little monsters, investigate the hidden dangers around him, and nip all hidden dangers in the bud. He was no longer as reckless and impulsive as before, patrolling all the way with extra caution. His heart was full of guilt. He only regretted that he had failed to stop the Black Wind Demon King and caused his sister to be seriously injured. From then on, he could only make up for the shortcomings in his heart by protecting her with all his strength.
During the day, the forest is quiet, the sun shines through the leaves, casting mottled light and shadow, and the aura outside the cave is peaceful and calm; after nightfall, the moonlight shines brightly, and the insects chirp. Only the footsteps of the guards intertwined with the sound of the steady aura flowing inside the cave, making the years temporarily peaceful.
In the cave, He Yue sat in meditation and adjusted his breathing. Under the warmth and nourishment of Hua Yue and He Nian, his injuries gradually improved. The remaining evil spirits in the divine palace were gradually eliminated, the damaged meridians were slowly repaired, the scattered Yuehua spiritual energy was reunited, and the whole body gradually glowed with a light silver glow, and the complexion became more and more complex.The color is rosy, and the pain between the brows is gradually dissipating.
On this day, He Yue slowly opened her eyes. Her eyes were warm and moist as before. Although she was still a little weak, she was no longer as weak as before. The moonlight aura around her body was flowing smoothly. Although she had not regained her peak strength, she was no longer in danger of her life. She could adjust her breathing and rest on her own.
"Thank you Fairy Yue Yue for spending many days to heal my wounds; thank you brother for guarding me day and night and protecting me; thank you third brother for guarding and guarding to keep this place peaceful." He Yue spoke softly, her voice soft but full of sincere gratitude, "It is really my fault that it has caused everyone to stagnate and consumed their minds."
"Sister, why do you need to say this!" He happened to come back from outside the cave. Hearing this, he spoke quickly, with a look of guilt on his face, "It's all my fault that I was incompetent and failed to stop the demon king, so you were seriously injured. It's me who should be sorry. You can rest peacefully and don't worry about the future. When you are completely healed, we will set off together again. There is no rush."
Hua Yue smiled lightly and handed over a wisp of spiritual energy from plants and trees to help stabilize it: "Goddess of the Moon, there is no need to blame yourself. It is a righteous act for you to sacrifice your life to protect others. Now that the injury is gradually recovering, it is the best. From now on, you only need to calm down and adjust your breath and replenish your vitality. The road ahead is long, so don't rush for a moment."
He Nian also walked into the cave. Seeing He Yue getting better, he was heartbroken and said warmly: "A family, people who are traveling together, should share weal and woe and protect each other, so how can we get in trouble. You can rest in peace, there is a formation to protect you here, and there is no danger. When the energy is completely restored, we will discuss the way forward."
He Yue looked at the concerned expressions of everyone, with warmth flowing in her heart. She nodded gently, said no more, closed her eyes again, and began to circulate the moonlight spiritual energy on her own, warming and nourishing the source, and repairing the remaining hidden wounds.
The cave fell into silence for a moment, with only the sound of spiritual energy flowing, peaceful and peaceful.
But this peace is only temporary after all.
